examples.label: Meeting people
examples.text: We cooked together in the common kitchen and went out with the other guests every night. I arrived alone and left with new friends.

examples.label: A comfortable stay
examples.text: The room was spotless and the bed was comfortable. The staff were helpful and the location was convenient for the bus station.

examples.label: Hard to connect
examples.text: Nobody spoke to each other. The common room was empty every evening and it was difficult to meet anyone.
